title: Increase quote card
description: A wide 16px-radius customer card washed from near-white into lime or sky blue at the bottom-right corner: a 48px logo tile, an 18px medium quote, a mono attribution and a mono note set right. Optional small arrow button in the top corner.
notes: the washes mix the theme's highlight or glow into its card colour, so they follow any theme
name: increase-quote-card

props.name: quote
props.description: the quote (shown as is, no quotation marks)

props.name: attribution
props.description: who said it, set in mono under the quote

props.name: note
props.description: a short mono line in the bottom corner (what the customer does with you)

props.name: mark
props.description: the 48px logo tile at the top

props.name: href
props.description: a link to the full story: shows a small arrow button in the top corner

props.name: linkLabel
props.description: label of that arrow button, for screen readers

props.name: tone
props.description: the wash deepening into the bottom-right corner: highlight (lime) or glow (blue)
